feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Edil and Daniela have demonstrated qualities that make them suitable candidates for BIP editors. Their experience includes active participation in relevant online discussions, particularly within the BIPs repository, suggesting a familiarity with the processes and standards required for this role.
Personal interactions further reinforce confidence in their capabilities, as direct meetings and ongoing communication have provided insight into their professionalism and engagement. These factors collectively indicate readiness to contribute effectively to the responsibilities of BIP editing.
